10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

261371|c0c247fc.name: Vrang Wildgore
261371|c0c247fc.text:
Those humans got what they deserved. 

<Vrang spits on the ground.>

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

5901|91558eae.name: Islen Waterseer
5901|91558eae.text: You've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around you and you shall fare far greater than most.

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1150-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-progress.text:
You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.
1150-progress.title: Test of Endurance

1151-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-progress.text: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.
1151-progress.title: Test of Strength

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

3090-progress.name: Nartok
3090-progress.text:
Finally, you've arrived... and discreetly also. Good.

Our world is full of fools, $N. Even the mighty Thrall has greater flaws than most can see. He turns his back on the power needed to make this land ours completely! We're not the same people who were manipulated and used by creatures from the Nether. We are our own people. We are proud... and we are strong.
3090-progress.title: Tainted Parchment

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-progress.name: Krusk
498-progress.text: You must make haste, $c. I shudder to think what the humans might be doing to Drull and Tog'thar.
498-progress.title: The Rescue

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The $c and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6384-progress.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6384-progress.text: Something smells good!  You don't have raw meat on you, do you?
6384-progress.title: Ride to Orgrimmar

6385-progress.name: Doras
6385-progress.text: Do you need one of my wind riders?
6385-progress.title: Doras the Wind Rider Master

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

79097-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79097-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097-progress.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

812-progress.name: Rhinag
812-progress.text: I'm almost glad I can't return to Sen'jin as I am now. My weakness and stupidity would surely be mocked.
812-progress.title: Need for a Cure

813-progress.name: Kor'ghan
813-progress.text: Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. That knowledge could save your life.
813-progress.title: Finding the Antidote

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

816-progress.name: Misha Tor'kren
816-progress.text: I pray that Kron will return to me, but I'm almost certain I know his fate already.
816-progress.title: Lost But Not Forgotten

822-progress.name: Brewmaster Drohn
822-progress.text: You working hard at finding those ingredients, $N?
822-progress.title: Chen's Empty Keg

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

883-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-progress.text: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
883-progress.title: Lakota'mani

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

885-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-progress.text:
There is new resolve within you, $N.  A resolve born from pain...

Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
885-progress.title: Washte Pawne

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

92401-accept.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-accept.text:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401-accept.title: A Frightened Request

92421-accept.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-accept.text:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421-accept.title: Light's Justice

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

95663-accept.name: Zaruk
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Titanic winds carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95663-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95663-complete.text: These are the courageous few? Mind your voices.
95663-complete.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-accept.name: Unknown
95664-accept.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664-accept.title: Elder Knowledge

95664-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-complete.text: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?
95664-complete.title: Elder Knowledge

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-accept.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-accept.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682-accept.title: Open the Maw

95682-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-complete.text:
Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.

I recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort. 

No matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.

Here, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.
95682-complete.title: Open the Maw

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-accept.name: Borstan
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95697-complete.name: Borstan
95697-complete.text: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!
95697-complete.title: Changing Tastes

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96-complete.name: Islen Waterseer
96-complete.text:
This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, $N.

I am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.

Use it well, and good luck.

Your next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a $c trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.
96-complete.title: Call of Water

96-progress.name: Islen Waterseer
96-progress.text:
You've returned. Splendid!

How went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?

It is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
96-progress.title: Call of Water

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

96241-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96241-accept.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241-accept.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96259-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-accept.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259-accept.title: Defending the Dead

96260-accept.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-accept.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260-accept.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-accept.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261-accept.title: The Broodmother

96876-complete.name: Ukor
96876-complete.text: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
96876-complete.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-complete.name: Kor'geld
97242-complete.text:
This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.

I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242-complete.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97246-accept.name: Thatog
97246-accept.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246-accept.title: Meal Appeal

97249-accept.name: Borstan
97249-accept.text:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249-accept.title: Favorite Food

97253-complete.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-complete.text:
Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.

Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
97253-complete.title: Parts and Pieces

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

97275-accept.name: Yelmak
97275-accept.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275-accept.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-complete.name: Whuut
97275-complete.text:
Grorru--whaa?

You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.

Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.

$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275-complete.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-progress.name: Whuut
97275-progress.text: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275-progress.title: Whuut's the Rush

97281-accept.name: Unknown
97281-accept.text:
<Before you is a strange orb and with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281-accept.title: A Simmering Storm

97281-complete.name: Rezlak
97281-complete.text: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
97281-complete.title: A Simmering Storm

97282-accept.name: Rezlak
97282-accept.text:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity come's knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282-accept.title: Stormy Potential

97282-complete.name: Rezlak
97282-complete.text:
Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.

Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.

Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
97282-complete.title: Stormy Potential

97282-progress.name: Rezlak
97282-progress.text:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282-progress.title: Stormy Potential

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97558-accept.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558-accept.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97985-accept.name: Calder Gray
97985-accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985-accept.title: Thundering Hearts

98069-complete.name: Jandia
98069-complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
98069-complete.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-complete.name: Jandia
98070-complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
98070-complete.title: Stop the Screeching

98094-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
98094-accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094-accept.title: Scout Support

98094-complete.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98094-complete.text:
Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.

Well, let's see what you have then.
98094-complete.title: Scout Support

98095-accept.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98095-accept.text:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095-accept.title: Valuable Vantages

98095-complete.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98095-complete.text:
Good work. We advance the plans.

Deathstalkers dare.

Let purpose guide your strikes, $N.
98095-complete.title: Valuable Vantages

98823-accept.name: Bashana Runetotem
98823-accept.text:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.

You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823-accept.title: Earthen Echo
